lead_headline: Intel details D270 inference GPU and 480GB partner option
facebook_post:
Intel's D270 targets memory-heavy AI inference: its own card has 160GB of LPDDR5X, while partner-built versions can offer up to 480GB. The 350W design and 1.5TB/s bandwidth are vendor specifications—not independent production benchmarks.

Today's Sapiver Forge Daily Brief also examines Anthropic's equity fund, Stand's wildfire modelling and HybridAgents research.
